subject: Conditional net terms & escrow option for high-volume invoicing
messages:
From: Oliver Hayes <oliver.hayes@novacare.com>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: NovaCare Finance <accounts-payable@novacare.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0400
Subject: Payment terms request + PO attached

Hi Hannah,

Hope you're well — we've completed procurement review on the upcoming integration pilot. Attached is our PO for the first three months (NovaCare_PO_202610.pdf). Our standard terms are Net60, but because this is a high-volume pilot and we may need to hold a small percentage pending QA, our finance team would prefer an escrow arrangement of 10% on monthly invoices for the first two billing cycles.

Also: we operate cross-border (US/EU) and need invoice-level VAT treatment and a VAT invoice included for all months where EU services are consumed. Can Redwood provide VAT-compliant invoices and a point of contact for tax paperwork?

Thanks — if possible we'd like to sign off this week.

Best,
Oliver
Oliver Hayes
Sr. Procurement Manager | NovaCare Therapeutics
[Attachment: NovaCare_PO_202610.pdf (pdf)]

From: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Hayes <oliver.hayes@novacare.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 3 Oct 2026 11:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Payment terms request + PO attached

Oliver — thanks for the PO and the clear ask. We're excited to get NovaCare onboarded. A few quick notes/questions so we can move fast: 

- Escrow: Redwood can support a custodial escrow arrangement via a trust account for disputed amounts, but we generally try to limit escrow to exceptional cases. Can you outline the scenarios you expect to trigger a hold? That'll help us size the threshold (10% vs 5%).
- Net terms: We typically offer Net45 for strategic pilots with predictable volume; Net60 is possible with a credit review and a capped credit limit. Would NovaCare be open to Net45 with a rolling credit cap of $150k for the pilot period, then re-evaluate?
- VAT/tax: We can produce VAT invoices where applicable. Please send the EU VAT registrations for your entities or let us know if you want Redwood to issue invoices to the US entity with a VAT reverse-charge note.

I've attached our standard credit application and a counterproposal for terms (Redwood_CreditApp_202610.docx; Redwood-Terms-Counterproposal-202610.pdf). Ben and Lauren — looping you for approval on the Net45 + $150k cap or to suggest alternatives.

If Oliver can confirm the escrow triggers and the legal entity for billing, we can get a signed DocuSign back by Thursday.

Cheers,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_CreditApp_202610.docx; Redwood-Terms-Counterproposal-202610.pdf]

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 08:37:00 -04:00
Subject: Fwd: Payment terms request + PO attached (internal)

Hannah / team —

Quick internal take before we respond: I'm supportive of Net45 with the $150k rolling cap for the pilot given the strategic nature of NovaCare. For the escrow, propose a conditional 5% hold for first invoice and escalate to 10% only if repeated invoice disputes occur — call it a two-strike rule. Also propose a 1% early-payment discount if they pay Net30.

Lauren — we should confirm with Finance (Monica) that our trust account setup can handle this escrow flow and whether we need any KYC from NovaCare beyond the credit app. Marcus — want you to own the commercial note (early-pay discount) in the SOW addendum.

-ben

[Internal comment: need to ensure product delivery SLOs are included in the SOW to reduce dispute likelihood.]

From: Oliver Hayes <oliver.hayes@novacare.com>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: NovaCare Finance <accounts-payable@novacare.com>, CFO Office <cfo@novacare.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 10:22:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Payment terms request + PO attached

Hannah / Ben — thanks for the quick review and the counterproposal. We can accept Net45 provided the rolling credit cap is $150k for the pilot. Regarding escrow triggers: holds would only be used for substantive invoice disputes where we evidence missed delivery or data integrity issues in the integration (we expect this to be rare). 5% initial hold with the two-strike inflow sounds reasonable.

A couple of requests before signing:
- We need proof of Redwood's cyber insurance policy (certificate of insurance) and an up-to-date W-9 for our vendor setup.
- For EU VAT, NovaCare will provide VAT numbers for the EU subsidiary — please confirm Redwood will add VAT line items when those are supplied.

We'll get the VAT registrations and the vendor setup info to you by EOD tomorrow. Once we have the COI and W-9, we'll route the DocuSign.

Regards,
Oliver
[Attachment: none]

From: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Hayes <oliver.hayes@novacare.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 09:10:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Payment terms request + PO attached — docs and next steps

Oliver — great, thanks for confirming. Monica is looping in our finance ops to deliver the W-9 and certificate of insurance. Next steps: 

1) NovaCare to upload VAT registrations + vendor setup details to the DocuSign packet (we'll include a vendor onboarding form).
2) Redwood to send finalized agreement with Net45, $150k rolling cap, 5% initial escrow (two-strike escalation to 10%), and 1% Net30 early-payment discount.
3) Both parties sign via DocuSign.

I've created the DocuSign envelope and attached the link below — it includes the credit app, the SOW addendum with the escrow language, and the vendor onboarding form. If everyone agrees, please sign and upload the VAT docs.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/embeddedSigning?env=demo&acct=12345&doc=NC-202610

Thanks — aiming to have this executed by COB Friday.

-Hannah
[Attachment: DocuSign_NovaCare_Agreement_202610.pdf]

From: Oliver Hayes <oliver.hayes@novacare.com>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: NovaCare Finance <accounts-payable@novacare.com>, cfo@novacare.com
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 16:48:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Payment terms request + PO attached — signed

Hannah — signing complete. We've uploaded the EU VAT registrations and our vendor onboarding details to the DocuSign packet, and accounts-payable will route the first invoice on the Net45 schedule after the first monthly usage report. COI and W-9 have been attached to vendor setup.

Looking forward to the kickoff. Please confirm the expected date for the first invoice and whether Redwood will prorate the first month given the mid-month SOW start.

Oliver
Sr. Procurement Manager | NovaCare Therapeutics
[Attachment: NovaCare_VAT_regs_202610.pdf; NovaCare_W9_202610.pdf]
